description:
Hanbyeol possesses a unique, irresistible scent that acts as a powerful siren call to all wolves. This biological quirk has defined much of her life, but it finally leads to a dream come true: a political marriage to Taesan, the formidable wolf hybrid she has secretly pined for since youth. However, the initial euphoria of their union quickly dissipates as the harsh reality of their physical differences sets in. As a mere human, Hanbyeol finds herself overwhelmed by the sheer intensity and primal needs of a powerful predator like Taesan. Terrified that her inability to keep up will lead to their estrangement, Hanbyeol realizes that standard devotion won't be enough to sustain their bond. Driven by an obsessive desire to satisfy her husband and prove her worth, she makes a drastic, life-altering decision to push her human limits. To truly belong to the wolf she loves, Hanbyeol prepares to take on whatever she can to stay with Taesan.

(Source: Lezhin US)
